name: The Big Whale MCP
description:
The Big Whale (TBW) is Europe's leading B2B intelligence provider for institutional players in crypto and digital assets. This connector gives Claude direct, structured access to TBW's exclusive editorial intelligence and proprietary market data — in natural language.

What you can do:
• Search TBW's editorial corpus — exclusive analyses, interviews, investigations and Weekly Briefings written by TBW journalists and researchers.
• Track crypto news — a curated third-party news wire (CoinDesk, The Block, Decrypt…), editorially scored and sentiment-classified, ideal for daily digests and market monitoring.
• Explore regulation — MiCA / CASP / EMT / ART licences, regulators and national registrations across Europe and beyond.
• Profile people & companies — key figures and firms (banks, funds, crypto-native players, regulators) tracked by TBW.
• Pull market data — BTC dominance, ETF flows, stablecoin metrics, RWA TVL and other proprietary indicators, with historical time series.
• Browse TBW events — Corporate Breakfasts, Market Calls and Deep Dives, with speakers and recaps.
• Read bank annual reports — the indexed full text of major banks' annual reports (BNP Paribas, Santander, JPMorgan, HSBC…), searchable down to the relevant section.

Built for professionals — fund managers, bankers, legal and corporate teams — who need institutional-grade, citable digital-asset intelligence directly in Claude. Every result links back to its source on the TBW webapp.

Access requires a TBW API key (provided to subscribers).

_published_faq.name: How do I add The Big Whale MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add The Big Whale MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.thebigwhale.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the The Big Whale MCP MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Big Whale MCP provides these MCP tools: get_graph_data, get_latest_market_snapshot, list_companies, list_dashboards, list_events, list_graphs, list_licences, list_news, list_people, and search_content.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to The Big Whale MCP?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to The Big Whale MCP in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.

_published_faq.name: Does The Big Whale MCP MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Big Whale MCP requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Who develops The Big Whale MCP?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Big Whale MCP is developed by The Big Whale. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
